title: Marcos leads groundbreaking ceremony of Metro Manila Subway NAIA Terminal 3 station
summary: The NAIA Terminal 3 station will be built beneath the NAIA Terminal 3 Open Parking and will be able to serve up to 70,000 passengers daily.
